description: Policy-derived candidate rows showing suggested notional amounts for open currency exposures. Read-only - does not execute trades, open dealing pages, or transfer assets.

entity_id.description: Limit to a single entity. Omit for group-level candidates.

policy_override.description: Temporary policy adjustments for this calculation only. Does not modify the stored policy.

max_tenor_days.description: Override maximum forward contract tenor in days.

name: get_protection_candidates

outputSchema.description: Hedgr MCP envelope. Inspect connection_status.state before relying on data. Mirrors mcp/schema/connection_status.json (inlined because MCP hosts do not resolve external $refs reliably).

connected_systems.description: Identifiers of connected accounting systems, e.g. ['xero:acme-uk', 'qbo:acme-us'].

last_sync.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of most recent successful data sync.

missing_systems.description: Entity IDs configured in policy but not yet connected. Present in 'partial' state.

setup_options.description: Available Hedgr setup surfaces to mention without implying a single provider path.

setup_reason.description: Plain-English reason Hedgr cannot answer with exposure data yet.

setup_steps.description: Ordered next steps the assistant should show when state is setup_required, including Save workspace to cloud for CSV/manual workspaces.

setup_url.description: Deep link to Hedgr settings/setup. Present when state is 'setup_required' or 'partial'.

state.description: ready: at least one server-readable source is connected, such as an accounting provider, Google Sheets, or saved CSV/manual cloud workspace, with data fresh (<24h). setup_required: no server-readable source is connected, data is null - surface setup_url and setup_steps. partial: some entities/sections connected, data covers only connected entities/sections. stale: connected but last_sync >24h - warn before executing.

data.description: Tool-specific payload. Null when connection_status.state is 'setup_required'.
